tasks.title: Secure identity, tenant isolation, and role permissions
tasks.spec: Implement the Supabase auth/profile foundation for employees, businesses, tenants, and platform administrators. Include SQL migrations, tenant-scoped foreign keys and indexes, RLS policies for every exposed table, and server-side role checks. Document exact tables, columns, relationships, and callable functions in sdocs/schema-contract.md. Never trust client-supplied tenant or role identifiers.

tasks.title: Employee directory and workload capacity
tasks.spec: Create the employee directory and workload model needed to route work to the eligible employee with the least outstanding workload. Include migrations, indexes, tenant-aware RLS, assignment/workload update functions, and contract documentation.

tasks.title: Help Desk ticket lifecycle and routing
tasks.spec: Implement the complete ticket lifecycle: intake, categorization, assignment, acceptance, status transitions, comments, and workload-aware routing. Include SQL constraints, indexes, RLS, transactional RPC/Edge Functions where needed, and schema-contract entries.

tasks.title: Audit, governance, and verified completion
tasks.spec: Implement append-only audit events and the governance/verification workflow used to approve completed work. Include actor, tenant, ticket, evidence, decision, timestamps, RLS, indexes, and secure server-side verification functions. Rewards must not be issued before verified completion.

tasks.title: Stars, badges, rewards, and notification ledger
tasks.spec: Implement idempotent star transactions, badge criteria/awards, configurable reward values, early-acceptance bonuses, and notification records. Prevent duplicate awards with unique constraints and award completion stars only after governance verification. Document all contracts.

tasks.title: Global Command Center application shell and navigation
tasks.spec: Build the application shell/header and then deliver up to five consecutive complete page destinations per 10-minute cycle, starting with the top-level menu, its first workspace submenu and pages, then proceeding workspace-by-workspace in approved order. Follow sdocs/FRONTEND_PAGE_BUILD_PLAYBOOK.md and sdocs/FRONTEND_BUILD_PROGRESS.json. Five is a maximum target, not a reason to ship incomplete pages. Wire all actions to real schema-contract endpoints; record the sequence cursor and only hand off as needs_verification. Also implement the authenticated blue-holographic homepage shell with Daytime/Nighttime themes and compact global clocks, provider-backed news/stock widgets, and permission-filtered Quick Picks per sdocs/HOMEPAGE_DASHBOARD_HELP_BUDDY_BUILD_CONTRACT.md. Login page is already implemented; do not rebuild it.

tasks.title: Help Desk queue and ticket intake module
tasks.spec: Build the Help Desk queue and intake experience with filters, search, ticket creation, ticket details, status changes, and live Supabase reads/mutations using only documented schema-contract entries. Include loading, error, and empty states.

tasks.title: Bring the Work to You and workload-aware assignment
tasks.spec: Build the Bring the Work to You experience with incoming assignment notifications, accept/decline actions, workload visibility, and least-outstanding-work routing feedback. Wire every button to real documented endpoints and handle duplicate/expired assignments.

tasks.title: Audit and Governance verification workspace
tasks.spec: Build an audit/governance workspace for reviewing ticket evidence, verification decisions, audit history, and rejected work. Use live documented Supabase queries and mutations with role-aware controls.

tasks.title: Employee stars, badges, and progress center
tasks.spec: Build the employee rewards experience showing star ledger, badge progress, verified completions, and reward history. Read authoritative server-side ledger data; never calculate or grant authoritative rewards in the browser.

tasks.title: Administration, policy, and configuration center
tasks.spec: Build administrative screens for tenant/role-aware configuration of routing, reward values, acceptance windows, and governance policies. Validate inputs and persist through documented secured endpoints.

tasks.title: Generate all pending repository visual assets
tasks.spec: Process all pending data-prompt image tags across the entire repository using scripts/generate-page-images.js. Before generating, read sdocs/IMAGE_REFERENCE_GUIDE.md and use the committed reference masters under public/images/reference/ for character, robot, hologram, lighting, and Command Center continuity. The two source JPGs must exist in the repository; ChatGPT attachments are not automatically available to GitHub Actions. Generate real local assets under public/images/, update src paths, and verify every referenced file.

tasks.title: Help Buddy modules, tabs, and cross-page navigation
tasks.spec: Implement Help Buddy's full module navigation and real page switching for Attachments & Voice, Conversations, Help Buddy Dashboard, Help Buddy Studio, Knowledge Assistance, Notes & Reminders, Tasks & Checklists, and Team Coordination using exact destinations in the master spec. Tabs must route to real pages, support browser history/direct links/responsive layouts, preserve safe state, enforce permissions, and use only documented schema-contract endpoints. Follow sdocs/HOMEPAGE_DASHBOARD_HELP_BUDDY_BUILD_CONTRACT.md.

tasks.title: Homepage appearance and dashboard preferences
tasks.spec: Implement authenticated user preferences for Daytime/Nighttime appearance, configured global clocks and approved Quick Picks metadata where appropriate. Define tenant/user scoping, RLS, indexes, validation, audit requirements and exact schema/API contracts. Do not fabricate news/market data; provider configuration belongs behind approved Connector Hub integrations. Follow sdocs/HOMEPAGE_DASHBOARD_HELP_BUDDY_BUILD_CONTRACT.md.

tasks.title: Help Buddy module data contracts
tasks.spec: Implement only the Supabase-owned, tenant-scoped Help Buddy data models and secure APIs needed for module metadata, notes/reminders/tasks or conversation metadata where not owned by another authoritative service. Enforce RLS, server-side permissions, audit, private-content boundaries and explicit schemas. Do not duplicate IntelliDesk, IntelliBase, calendar or task-service ownership. Follow sdocs/HOMEPAGE_DASHBOARD_HELP_BUDDY_BUILD_CONTRACT.md.
